managerChanges: final v1.0.0 UI keeps profiler-status prose white and colors only semantic status markers
disabled actions render gray; available forward actions use cyan and available restore uses magenta
CapFrameX 1.9.1.2 Beta is the tested frame-time reference build while frame-time pairing remains optional
recognized CapFrameX report timeline supports Shift plus mouse-wheel zoom around the pointer
native launcher and managed application use the final multi-size G-CET Windows icon
v1.0.0 stable standalone release uses a portable ZIP with package-local settings and RESULTS
second-page readiness UI uses green confirmed states, warnings for optional/pending states, and red only for blocking errors
restore confirmation suppresses activation refresh so clicking Yes cannot be swallowed by the automatic status refresh
optional frame-time companion can be launched from the capture page when a configured executable exists
two-page setup keeps optional frame-time pairing separate from CET/0-Engine installation and recovery
optional frame-time companion detection is read-only; CapFrameX start-key detection recognizes CaptureHotKey without modifying CapFrameX
companion captures are copied into the CET archive under FrameTime and are never deleted from their source
the single CETProfiler_Toggle input uses F11 only as an initial default; an existing or user-changed CET binding is preserved

known CET runtime output patterns are copied, verified, then removed from the live CET folder; unrelated files are never swept
CET keybinds are user-controlled and are never rolled back by profiler restore
standalone RESULTS remain package-local; TOTAL Profiler does not redirect profiler-owned output paths
0-Engine core-only mode is presented as a fallback only when safe Scheduler integration is unavailable or fails

recognized unintegrated/custom 0-Engine versions are patched transactionally using their own init.lua
adaptive mode uses unique modules/CETProfilerScheduler.lua to avoid colliding with 0-Engine Scheduler.lua
existing PASS/Scheduler-integrated 0-Engine keeps the proven Scheduler.lua swap path
